scope: Post-processing (roadmap M6, first increment): HDR scene, emission-driven bloom, tonemapping, MSAA and FXAA; no game, engine or renderer code imported

retail_evidence.purpose: CityHub and SubwayA captures used to choose the bloom strength (1.5) and the filmic exposure (2.2), and checked by gpu.post.

design_references.source: Jimenez, 'Next Generation Post Processing in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare' (SIGGRAPH 2014 Advances in Real-Time Rendering)
design_references.purpose: 13-tap downsample, Karis average on the first pass and 3x3 tent upsample of the bloom chain.
1 / (1 + luma) weighting of the first downsample against bright-texel flicker.

design_references.source: Khronos Group, 'Khronos PBR Neutral Tone Mapper' (2024, specification and sample code)
design_references.purpose: Shoulder of the NEUTRAL tonemap: compression start 0.76, desaturation 0.15. The toe offset is not used.

design_references.source: Hill, BakingLab ACES.hlsl (MJP, 2016; fit of the ACES RRT and ODT by Stephen Hill)
design_references.purpose: FILMIC tonemap: the RRT/ODT rational fit and its sRGB/working-space matrices.

design_references.source: Lottes, 'FXAA' (NVIDIA white paper, 2009-2011, FXAA 3.11 quality algorithm)
design_references.purpose: Algorithm of the FXAA pass (local contrast, edge orientation, end search, subpixel blend), reimplemented; no FXAA source is copied.
Transfer functions between the display-space scene and linear light.
